svg.title: RFLP probe detection and codominant alleles
svg.desc: Five schematic comparisons. A has three cleavage sites, a has only the flanking sites. The probe lies left of the central site. All gel strips migrate rightward: long a fragments stay left and short A fragments move right. AA and aa each show one co-migrating band, Aa shows both.
svg.metadata: Original vector construction. Source teaching facts and labels: image_003.jpg. Schematic; no measured fragment lengths or intensities.
svg.text: Site of hybridization with probe DNA
